name: Coefficient Space of the Oriented Bipartite-Graph Construction
parameters: $d_G=3|V(G)|+6|E(G)|+\binom{|V(G)|}{2}-|E(G)|$; $B_G$ is the complement of the diagonal subspaces indexed by inclusion-minimal directed-cycle supports.
proof: Private-coordinate elimination reduces the coefficient space to directed two-coordinate inequalities. Their difference map has base $B_G$ and explicit Euclidean fibers; all omitted coefficient ratios are free.
